newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunker quotes differ, directions mixed.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker quotes differ, directions mixed.

text.p: Singapore bunker quotes differed widely on Wednesday while traders were searching for a clear direction in the cargo market, which weakened on Tuesday despite recent strong anticipation for gains.

Some suppliers quoted the 380-cst grade at above $100 per tonne while some offered as low as $95/$96. "It is very confusing," said one trader. However, traders agreed that many shipowners were holding back and unwilling to trade.
The 180-cst was quoted by majors at around $103/$105. MDO and gas oil were at $190/$193 and $200/$205 respectively.
